title: Keep verifies links pinned when criterion content changes
preconditions: A separate case verifies a specific criterion revision; preserve the original relation pin.

steps.action: Change the statement of that exact criterion while preserving its identity, then inspect the verifies relation.
steps.expected_result: The relation keeps its old pin and reports the changed criterion stale.

steps.action: Explicitly repin the relation to the changed criterion revision and inspect it again.
steps.expected_result: The mapping becomes current only after the deliberate repin.

expected_result: Keep verifies links pinned when criterion content changes.
